Hi,

This is a pretty simple model, but I cannot make it work. Below is my reproducible code with data attached.

public_data <- read.csv("public_data.csv")
ability_model <- '
ability =~ f_test_score + l_test_score
# covariances and variances - tried all of the below but no luck
# l_test_score ~~ f_test_score
# l_test_score ~~ l_test_score
# f_test_score ~~ f_test_score
'
ability_fit <- cfa(ability_model, data = public_data,
          std.lv=TRUE # the metric of each latent variable is determined by fixing their variances to 1.0.
           )
summary(ability_fit, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, ci = TRUE)

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: not identified CFA model (code and data available)
parts:
Yes, the model is not identified. You need eitehr 3 congeneric indicators per factor or 2 congeneric indicators per factor if each factor covaries with another variable. You have only 2 indicators per factor and no other variable. You could make the model identified by forcing the loadings of the two indicators to be equal:

ability =~ a*f_test_score + a*l_test_score

for example.
